verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a public source repository or an open-source license for HumanLayer. The docs describe running the HumanLayer stack on your own workstation or remote workers, but self-hosting is not the same as readable source under an open license. One community comment ('didn't think to open source them') only hints that HumanLayer may be open source and does not establish any license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
